description: This file is a shell script containing test cases designed for a Git repository. It sets up various commit histories, performs merges, pulls, and conflict resolutions to test the behavior of Git merge operations, especially octopus merges. It also verifies the state of files and commits after operations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success execution of subsequent commands.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a specific path is a file.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that a command fails as expected.
